Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: we covered your main pain points (unpredictable latency at peak, high per-token cost, and need for private deployment for regulated data).
- Goal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive + demo with your infra/ML engineers to validate perf and integration footprint.
- Ask: can we land a recurring/rotating slot so your global team (US/EU/APAC) can join without always changing times?

Suggested rotating cadence (we can rotate weekly or bi-weekly):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 9:00–10:30 PT (12:00–13:30 ET) — good for product owners + SREs in US.
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 14:00–15:30 CET — good overlap for EU-based engineers.
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 10:00–11:30 SGT/AWST — morning APAC, late evening US optional.

If that looks reasonable, I can send a few concrete time options across the next three weeks (we can set a rotating recurring invite). Please confirm:
- Which rotation cadence you prefer (weekly/bi-weekly)
- Names and roles of the Acme attendees for the deep dive (engineers/infra/product)
- Any calendar restrictions (blockout windows)

Attached: agenda.pdf (short proposed agenda).

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Camila Reyes
